Digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the plugin content, as the OCI manifest digest or the hash of the extracted tree.

kind.description: `data` for a data plugin, `code` for a code plugin. The same values as the manifest kind.

requires.description: Ids of locked plugins this entry needs. At most 256.

signature.description: Present when the host verified a minisign signature.

not_before.description: The notBefore time of the signed statement, in UTC (RFC 3339, `Z` suffix). The pattern rejects an impossible month, day, hour, minute or second, and 30 or 31 February. 29 February of a non-leap year passes the schema and fails when the host parses the time. `plugins update` refuses an older value than the lockfile holds unless the user passes the downgrade flag.

source.description: An oci:// reference, an https:// release archive URL, a git+https:// URL pinned to a full commit hash after @, or a path relative to the project root. A URL carries no user-info. A path has no colon, no backslash, no `..` segment and no line break, and it starts with a character that is neither white space nor a slash. http:// is rejected. The reader also refuses control characters and other unsafe characters anywhere in the value, and a value over 4096 bytes. The schema counts characters, so it caps the value at 4096 of them.

description: The .slopvac/plugins.lock file. `slopvac plugins sync` writes it and a run reads it. It pins each data plugin and code plugin to a version, a source and a content digest, so a run on another machine loads the same bytes. A digest mismatch makes the run fail with exit 2. The lockfile records no trust: trust is a separate per-user record. The built-in core plugin is compiled into the binary and never appears here. Semantics are specified in docs/contract/plugins.md.

plugins.description: Locked entries, sorted by id, so diffs stay small. At most 1000 entries.

title: slopvac v3 plugins lockfile
